name: Black & White Vintage Historical Photography
description: An authentic black-and-white historical documentary photography aesthetic with realistic human anatomy, accurate historical clothing, natural monochrome grayscale tonal variation, and subtle archival film grain.
system_instructions:
An authentic black-and-white historical documentary photography aesthetic. Every image should resemble a genuine photograph captured using historical photographic equipment and preserved in an archival collection.

Human subjects: Represent humans as realistic photographic subjects with natural anatomy, authentic facial features, realistic body proportions, natural expressions, and believable physical appearances. Clothing, hairstyles, uniforms, accessories, and other details should accurately reflect the historical period and context described in the script. People should look like real individuals captured by a camera, never illustrations, cartoons, or 3D characters.

Animals: Represent animals as realistic photographic subjects with accurate species-specific anatomy, natural proportions, realistic fur, feathers, skin, and physical characteristics. They must look like actual animals photographed in their environment.

Birds: Represent birds with realistic anatomy, natural feather structures, recognizable species characteristics, authentic wing shapes, beaks, tails, and natural poses. They must look like real birds captured through historical photography.

Environment and objects: All buildings, architecture, interiors, landscapes, streets, vehicles, ships, aircraft, machinery, furniture, weapons, tools, and other objects must be represented as realistic photographic subjects. Their appearance, construction, materials, and design must correspond to the historical period and geographical setting described in the script.

Photographic characteristics: Use authentic monochrome photographic rendering with natural grayscale tonal variation, realistic contrast, photographic grain, subtle film imperfections, period-appropriate sharpness, natural textures, and the appearance of historical photographic prints. The result should resemble genuine archival photography rather than a modern color image converted into black and white.

Aging and deterioration: Apply subtle age-related photographic characteristics such as grain, dust, scratches, fading, minor stains, paper texture, and slight imperfections where appropriate. Their intensity should vary naturally. Not every image should have heavily damaged edges, excessive scratches, or identical aging effects.

Script-driven visual direction: Lighting, exposure, shadows, contrast, atmosphere, weather, camera angle, focal length, framing, composition, depth of field, subject positioning, expressions, and photographic perspective must be determined by the actual script and the specific event being depicted. Do not force every image into the same lighting conditions, camera setup, composition, or mood. Preserve the visual characteristics of authentic historical photography while allowing each scene to reflect its own circumstances.

Historical consistency: Every scene must respect the time period, location, technology, architecture, clothing, transportation, and other historical details specified by the story. Avoid introducing modern objects, contemporary fashion, or anachronistic elements.

Avoid: Colorization, selective color, modern digital illustration, cartoon aesthetics, 3D rendering, artificial-looking humans, exaggerated cinematic effects, and repetitive artificial aging overlays.

The final image should look like a genuine historical photograph, with the photographic style remaining consistent while the lighting, atmosphere, composition, and visual storytelling adapt naturally to every scene. Key principle: PromptBeast should apply the visual identity consistently but let the script control the actual scene, lighting, atmosphere, camera, composition, and visual storytelling.
